review_method: Two independent assistant reviewers received only the sealed delivered-text packet and review plan; source, route, model identity, latency, runtime verdicts and withheld outputs were hidden. Review aggregation is not an additional independent review or human validation.
selection_policy: All quality, required-component and usefulness booleans agree. Flag and unsupported-subtype sets also agree. Retain reviewer A wording and booleans unchanged; differing prose descriptions and flag order require no scoring adjudication. Both independent originals remain unchanged.
